marketing_description: The DeWALT® DCN930P1 Framing Nailer, part of the 20V MAX* Series, delivers 58 nails per load with a 2‑to‑3½‑in range and 30‑ga clipped heads, fed from a 30‑degree strip magazine. Powered by a 20 V MAX XR® Lithium‑Ion 5 Ah battery and a brushless motor, it offers both bump and sequential actuation with tool‑free depth adjustment and an integrated dry‑fire lockout. An ergonomic soft‑grip handle in black/yellow and a stall‑release lever complete the design for reliable framing work.
